summary: Revisi rencana implementasi untuk mendukung hosting website Fullstack secara real-time: Server HTTP mandiri lengkap (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS), WebSocket server & Server-Sent Events (SSE) real-time, REST API & dynamic JSON/SQLite database backend, static asset server, Git clone/pull, file manager & editor kode monokrom, log streaming live, QR code LAN, dan tab pratinjau browser in-app.
